name: Mortgage appointment coordination
short: Keep borrower calls, application meetings, and internal reviews organized without taking lending decisions.
outcome: A dated, reviewable queue with a named owner for every unresolved item.
problem: A missing invitation, wrong time zone, or unrecorded reschedule can leave borrowers waiting and licensed staff rebuilding the calendar.
imageAlt: Calculator, folders, and glasses arranged on an administrative desk
idealFor: Mortgage operations teams with recurring administrative follow-up
Licensed staff who need calendar and record preparation support

scenarios.title: A practical starting assignment
scenarios.detail: A borrower requests a new appointment after a work shift changes. The assistant checks approved availability, sends a revised invitation, and alerts the originator to the change without discussing eligibility.

scenarios.title: An exception requires a decision
scenarios.detail: When the approved checklist does not resolve an issue, preserve the source record and return the question to the assigned reviewer before changing its status.

tasks: Receive meeting requests through the approved inbox
Confirm participant availability and time zones
Prepare calendar invitations with approved agenda and joining instructions
Record cancellations and offer permitted alternative times
Route questions about loan terms to the licensed owner
clientInputs: Role-based access to the designated systems
A named reviewer and escalation timetable
qualityControls: Check identifiers and dates against the source
Confirm recipient and appointment or document version
Have the owner review a sample before expanding the scope
boundaries: Loan terms, eligibility, underwriting, disclosures, legal interpretation, and approvals remain with licensed or authorized staff.
The assistant does not handle funds, approve wire changes, or declare a loan or document compliant.

launchSteps.title: Choose one queue
launchSteps.detail: Select a bounded calendar or document backlog with an accountable owner.

launchSteps.title: Write the handoff
launchSteps.detail: Agree the inputs, permitted actions, output format, and escalation time.

launchSteps.title: Review a pilot
launchSteps.detail: Inspect the first completed records before expanding the assignment.

faq.question: Does this replace licensed mortgage work?
faq.answer: No. This service prepares and coordinates administrative records. Your authorized team retains lending, legal, and compliance decisions.

faq.question: Can we use our current systems?
faq.answer: Yes. Define the permitted fields, access, and written workflow before the assistant receives an assignment.

faq.question: How do we know an item is complete?
faq.answer: Agree a checklist with the reviewer. Completion records include source evidence, dates, and the next owner; unanswered questions remain visible.

name: Post-closing document administration
short: Track outstanding administrative records and prepare an organized post-closing handoff for authorized review.
outcome: A dated, reviewable queue with a named owner for every unresolved item.
problem: After a closing, missing source documents and unclear ownership can leave the operations team repeatedly searching folders and email threads.
idealFor: Mortgage operations teams with recurring administrative follow-up
Licensed staff who need calendar and record preparation support

scenarios.title: A practical starting assignment
scenarios.detail: A recorded document has not arrived by the expected follow-up date. The assistant records its pending status, sends the permitted request, and alerts the reviewer; receipt is never treated as a legal or compliance determination.

scenarios.title: An exception requires a decision
scenarios.detail: When the approved checklist does not resolve an issue, preserve the source record and return the question to the assigned reviewer before changing its status.

tasks: Log documents received with source and date
Request missing administrative items using approved templates
Organize version-controlled records in the permitted repository
Flag mismatched identifiers and unresolved items to the file owner
